lede: Los Alamos celebrates with WinterFest weekend, a holiday lights parade, Santa events, an ice rink and a luminaria walk at the stables.
celebrates: Los Alamos MainStreet organizes WinterFest weekend, December 4 to 6, 2026, with the Holiday Lights Parade as the highlight and a list of events hosted by local businesses and groups. Families can eat Breakfast with Santa with the Kiwanis Club, decorate cookies at Santa's Workshop, skate with Santa at the county ice rink, watch Home Alone 2 with hot chocolate at PEEC Nature Center and stroll the Luminaria Walk at North Mesa Stables. The WinterFest page says activities will be posted all December.
lastyear: In 2025 the County of Los Alamos held its Holiday Lights Parade, according to the county's event page, and the Los Alamos Reporter wrote on December 15, 2025, that Christmas Eve at Ashley Pond returned with music, candlelight and community. The county's community services also shared a winter guide video with Santa's Workshop, ice skating with Santa and a New Year's skate.
facts: Los Alamos County runs its own ice rink at 4475 West Road, which hosts Skate with Santa and a New Year's Eve Skate. WinterFest includes a Creche Show of nativity displays from around the world, contributed by Los Alamos citizens. Dance Arts Los Alamos presents a Nutcracker on The Hill ballet trilogy, which the WinterFest schedule mentions when promoting its Big Bang variety show.
trains: Los Alamos has no train listing on this site. The closest family train is Sky Railway's Pablo's Holiday Express from the Lamy Depot near Santa Fe on December 5, 6, 12, 13 and 17 to 24, a one-hour ride with Mrs. Claus, story time, sing-alongs and hot cocoa. The Santa Fe guide has the details.

faq: When is the Los Alamos Holiday Lights Parade in 2026?

The Holiday Lights Parade is on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 6 pm during WinterFest weekend, December 4 to 6. The theme is Enchanted Los Alamos. The state tourism listing says there is no admission fee. The schedule does not print a route, so check the WinterFest page.
Where can kids meet Santa in Los Alamos?

On December 5 the Kiwanis Club holds Breakfast with Santa from 7:30 to 11:30 am, with reservations required, and County Recreation holds Santa's Workshop from 3:30 to 5:30 pm. On December 19 Santa visits the ice rink from 3:30 to 5 pm for Skate with Santa.
Is there ice skating in Los Alamos?

Yes. Los Alamos County runs the Ice Rink at 4475 West Road. Skate with Santa on December 19 costs $6.50 for ages 6 and up and $2.50 for ages 5 and under, and includes skate rental. A New Year's Eve Skate runs at the same rates.
Are there free Christmas events in Los Alamos?

Yes. The Holiday Lights Parade, Santa's Workshop, Breakfast with Santa and the Luminaria Walk at North Mesa Stables are all listed as free. Breakfast with Santa needs a reservation. Home Alone and Hot Chocolate at PEEC costs $10 for adults and $8 for children.
